"import csv
from openpyxl import Workbook

input_file = "eng_pivot_01.csv"
output_file = "output.xlsx"

data = {}
channels = set()

with open(input_file, "r", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as csv_file:
    reader = csv.DictReader(csv_file)
    required_columns = {"config", "channel", "rep", "value"}
    if reader.fieldnames is None or not required_columns.issubset(reader.fieldnames):
        raise ValueError("Input CSV must contain config, channel, rep, and value columns")

    for row in reader:
        config = row["config"]
        channel = row["channel"]
        value = float(row["value"])
        channels.add(channel)
        data.setdefault(config, {}).setdefault(channel, []).append(value)

sorted_channels = sorted(channels)
sorted_configs = sorted(data)

workbook = Workbook()
worksheet = workbook.active
worksheet.title = "SUMMARY"

header = ["config"] + sorted_channels
worksheet.append(header)

for config in sorted_configs:
    output_row = [config]
    for channel in sorted_channels:
        values = data[config].get(channel, [])
        mean = sum(values) / len(values) if values else 0
        output_row.append(round(mean, 3))
    worksheet.append(output_row)

workbook.save(output_file)"
